## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what should happen and what happened, including the recorded stop reason.

## Reproduction

Provide the command, relevant sanitized JSON and smallest reproducible example.
State whether the issue occurs in read-only planning or Worker execution.

## Environment

Include source revision, Python/backend versions, model architecture and GPU
model/driver when relevant. List any changed pins and missing local assets.

## Evidence

Include a sanitized traceback or receipt excerpt. Do not attach weights, private
images/answers or credentials. Use SECURITY.md for sensitive vulnerability reports.
